items.briefing:
The Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has issued a warning about critical vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway — products used by many organisations for remote access. If your organisation uses these systems, IT staff should apply patches immediately. Separately, Australian businesses are being reminded that privacy law reforms are on the way, and waiting until legislation passes before acting could leave you scrambling — reviewing how your organisation handles personal data now is strongly advised.

Ransomware remains a serious threat, with research showing many firms lack proper immutable backups, meaning attackers can delete recovery options before striking. Large enterprises are also being targeted by convincing fake merger and acquisition scams designed to trick staff into revealing sensitive information or transferring funds.

**Practical tip:** Check with your IT team that critical software — especially remote access tools — is fully up to date and patched.
